newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Memtec wins US$12 mln in filtration orders.
newsitem.headline: Memtec wins US$12 mln in filtration orders.

text.p: Water filtration group Memtec Ltd announced on Friday it had won orders for US$12 million worth of continuous microfiltration (CMF) technology.
The largest of these orders was from the City of Scottsdale, Arizona, Memtec said.
"During the next twelve months, more Memcor CMF capacity will be delivered than has previously been installed since 1986," Memtec said.
Memtec is also listed in the United States.
Memtec reported sales in the first half of the year to June 30, 1997 of A$147.68 million.
